$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (id column), each value checked against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings (localizations.id) and the app's Free/Plus comparison labels (FeatureQuotaManager.swift featureDisplayName); §7.2.2 rules ①–③ and fix X12; §7.3 id row (Anda; 'geser ke kanan', 'ketuk dua kali').

X12: the app titles the feature 'Gesek untuk Menerjemahkan' (daily_sentence_translation_limit) but its own tip says 'Geser ke kanan pada teks apa pun…' (tip_swipe_to_translate); the website uses 'geser' everywhere, so the kicker and the quota rows read 'Geser untuk Menerjemahkan' (reported to the app side).

required: kickers and quota-table rows use the app's names (rule ①). The lookup kicker drops the '(Arti AI)' suffix like en / ja / es / it; the quota rows join the engine and the AI pronunciation unit with ' · ' as en does ('· cloud' / '· lokal', '· kata' / '· kalimat'). Action Flow keeps the App Store name in headings and the sample (doc 08 D3, §7.2.3); the quota row uses the app's own comparison label 'Alur Tindakan Kalimat' (sentence_skeleton_settings_navigation_title), as zh-Hans / ko / it do.

contains: app button and screen names the sentences quote verbatim in “ ” (rule ①; T-B get_syntax_explanation_button, view_title_swipe_history; T-C audio_playback_title_*; T-E upgrade_now_button / restore_purchase_button).

banned: 'gesek' (X12); left swipes (F14); mouse wording (X7 by analogy); a single tap for lookup (doc 08 §1.1); variants of the app names; the informal 'kamu' (doc 08 §7.3: Anda); Malay words that leaked into one app string (tts_trial_exhausted_fallback_message: 'percubaan percuma', 'sebutan tempatan', 'naik taraf' — rule ③, reported to the app side; in Indonesian 'percuma' means 'in vain').
